person_note: The book is predominantly a sequence of third-person vignettes focalized through Mrs. Miniver, but its regular contents include the sustained first-person letter 'From Needing Danger,' narrated and signed by Caroline. That constitutive epistolary section warrants ALTERNATING rather than THIRD; q00385 comes from it, while the many visible 'I,' 'we,' and 'you' forms elsewhere are dialogue, local thought, or generic address. Later editions may append further first-person letters, but the target structure already alternates because of the included letter, so edition variation does not change the label.
